about: ctrlsave 2026-11-25, the user: 'The controller setting (6 button vs N64) setting doesn't persist after closing the game. It defaults back to 6 button.' The first start of two: the game in Regular from a settings file holding CONTROL MODE 6-BUTTON; F2 opened (the key), player 1's controller goes down the main page to CONTROLS (6 rows down), A, LEFT on CONTROL MODE (6-BUTTON to N64), F2 again (SAVE AND EXIT); then the game quits on its own. ctl_mode_restart_n64 starts that game folder again. bs_* = qa_ctlmode's (logic.c qa_state). Before the fix the load read the continue timer for it (always 6-BUTTON) and the save stored 6-BUTTON whatever was picked.

expect.name: the settings were read: CONTROL MODE 6-BUTTON, as the settings file holds it
F2 opened, on the CONTROLS page (player 1 went down the main page and pressed A)
CONTROL MODE set to N64 on that page, F2 not closed yet
SAVE AND EXIT: F2 closed, CONTROL MODE N64, and the settings hold N64 after the save
N64 at the end, F2 closed
